parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the access control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.

parameters.name: EffectScope
parameters.description:
The effective scope of the access control policy.

The value RAM indicates that the access control policy takes effect only for RAM users and RAM roles.

parameters.name: PolicyDocument
parameters.description:
The document of the access control policy.

The document can be a maximum of 4,096 characters in length.

For more information about the languages of access control policies, see [Languages of access control policies](~~179096~~).

For more information about the examples of access control policies, see [Examples of custom access control policies](~~181474~~).

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the access control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag to add to the access control policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster create-control-policy --policy-name ExampleControlPolicy --description ExampleControlPolicy --effect-scope RAM --policy-document Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --control-policy-type RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY --region cn-hangzhou
